decisions.reason: Cleaning soap is a low-cost accessory tied to the firm's wood-surface know-how and its maintenance offering, so the firm can readily judge its performance and keep it to support floor sales.
Maintenance oil draws directly on the firm's surface-treatment expertise and complements its oiled floors, giving it strong absorptive capacity to refine the line.
Care products for oiled floors build closely on existing finishing knowledge and customer relationships, making the line easy to interpret and improve.
Moisture-protection underlay is a sourced accessory further from the core wood know-how, but it is strategically useful for complete installation systems, so it stays.
High-density foam underlay rests on less internal knowledge and may overlap with other underlays, but it supports system sales at low cost and is likely kept.
An oak parquet line is the firm's core competence, where its wood-processing knowledge and production investment give it the highest capacity to learn from and develop the product.
